recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the omitted cross-reference from FHIR-14272 while preserving later FHIR-I decisions about isSummary guidance and datatype exceptions; related later issues do not need separate reconciliation from this seed.
issue_request: FHIR-14272 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for STU3. It asked to clarify that the isSummary rule applies to resource and data type definitions rather than independently to constraining profiles, to add a reference to elementdefinition.html#interpretation, and not to add a FHIRPath invariant or change min=1 to >=1.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by git-svn commit 0ee58a1919478a7b1de01e3dbe29b649b13080f6 (GF#14272 - improve wording, svn revision 14311), which replaced the old broad summary-elements sentence in source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml with scoped resource/data type definition wording. That application did not add the requested interpretation-table reference.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes elementdefinition and marks ElementDefinition normative, so source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml is build-scope source for the detailed ElementDefinition descriptions. source/elementdefinition.html already contains the #interpretation section and the isSummary row explaining type and constraint-definition behavior. The direct Zulip thread confirms the intent that profiles cannot change isSummary, and later FHIR-35855, FHIR-33148, and FHIR-46364 refine the same comment text without conflicting with a cross-reference.
reconciliation: Edited source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml to append a concise link to [Interpretation of ElementDefinition in different contexts](elementdefinition.html#interpretation) from the ElementDefinition.isSummary comments. No invariant or rule change was introduced.
source_changes: source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml: added a See also link from ElementDefinition.isSummary comments to elementdefinition.html#interpretation.

related_jiras.note: Later issue removed misleading per-profile isSummary wording after noting that the interpretation table says constraints cannot change isSummary.
Later issue expanded the same ElementDefinition.isSummary comment with descendant and datatype-exception guidance; this reconciliation preserves that wording.
Later issue refined the descendant rule to descendants within the same StructureDefinition; this reconciliation preserves that refinement.
